verdict.rationale: Autumn documents its own plan-attach flow, which handles new subscriptions and creates a Stripe subscription. It also offers a charge preview and a customer billing portal, so it does drive paid subscriptions through Stripe. However, the evidence never shows card capture or a hosted checkout page, and nothing supports going from signup to a live payment within a day. Card processing also depends on a separate Stripe account, the only supported processor. Missing for 10: documented card checkout or payment-capture flow, evidence of time-to-first-live-payment (onboarding or Stripe connection steps), hands-on corroboration of a fast go-live.
